## Motivation

Source-kernel XPU nightly images are tagged `nightly-dev-xpu-bmg-<date>-<sha>-main-main-<kernel sha>`, but their rolling tag was `latest-kernel-main`. Rename the rolling tag to `latest-main-main` to match.

Also, when `release-branch-cut.yml` runs the XPU wheel nightly, dump one CSV of every test file run in that job (stage-a/stage-b PR suites + wheel nightly suite), so the release result can be read without digging through logs.

## Modifications

- `release-docker-intel-xpu-nightly.yml`: `latest_tag=latest-kernel-main` -> `latest_tag=latest-main-main` (and the comment).
- `nightly-test-intel.yml`: the 4 `--image-tag latest-kernel-main` container pulls now use `latest-main-main`, so the nightly tests keep tracking the fresh image.

The wheel rolling tag (`latest`) is unchanged.

- `nightly-test-intel-wheel.yml`, **release branch cut only** (`inputs.ref` set; scheduled/dispatch runs unchanged):
  - The stage-a + stage-b step also writes per-file metrics (`SGLANG_TEST_METRICS_FILE`).
  - New steps merge it with the wheel nightly metrics into `xpu-wheel-1-gpu-results.csv` (`file_name,suite,status,duration`) and upload it as the `xpu-wheel-1-gpu-results-csv` artifact.
- `scripts/ci/xpu/metrics_to_csv.py`: the merger. Each file's suite comes from its `register_xpu_ci` call, since stage-a and stage-b run pooled in one `run_suite.py` call.

## Rollout note

`intel/sglang-dev:latest-main-main` exists only after the first release-docker run on `main` after merge, so trigger `release-docker-intel-xpu-nightly` manually right after merging, before the next Intel nightly. The old `latest-kernel-main` tag stays on Docker Hub but stops advancing.

## Checklist

- [x] YAML parses, pre-commit passes
- [x] actionlint: no new findings vs `main` (same 9 pre-existing ones)
- [x] Changed steps rendered for both `inputs.ref` set/empty: `bash -n` clean, env/args passed as expected
- [x] `metrics_to_csv.py` on the v0.5.23 branch-cut run's data: 55 rows (8 stage-a, 38 stage-b, 9 wheel nightly), all suites resolved
- [ ] First real CSV: next release branch cut after merge

+          suites=stage-a-test-1-gpu-xpu,stage-b-test-1-gpu-xpu
+          # Release branch cut: one call per suite, so each metrics file maps to one suite.
+          if [ "${{ inputs.ref != '' }}" = true ]; then suites="${suites/,/ }"; fi
+          for suite in $suites; do
+            docker exec ci_sglang_xpu bash -c "
+              source /opt/venv/bin/activate &&
+              cd /sglang-checkout/test &&
+              GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY=/sglang-checkout/github_summary_ci.md \
+              SGLANG_IS_IN_CI=true \
+              ${{ inputs.ref && 'SGLANG_TEST_METRICS_FILE=/sglang-checkout/$suite-metrics.jsonl' || '' }} \
+              python3 run_suite.py --hw xpu --suite $suite --timeout-per-file 600 --retry-timeout-increase 0 --enable-retry ${{ (github.event_name == 'schedule' || inputs.continue_on_error) && '--continue-on-error' || '' }}
+            " || TEST_EXIT_CODE=$?
+          done
           echo "$(<github_summary_ci.md)" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY || true
           exit ${TEST_EXIT_CODE:-0}
 
@@ -169,6 +175,38 @@ jobs:
           if-no-files-found: warn
           retention-days: 30
 
+      # Release branch cut only: one CSV of every test file run in this job.
+      - name: Generate per-file results CSV
+        if: always() && inputs.ref != ''
+        run: |
+          docker exec -i -w /sglang-checkout ci_sglang_xpu /opt/venv/bin/python3 - <<'EOF'
+          import csv, json, os
+          suites = ["stage-a-test-1-gpu-xpu", "stage-b-test-1-gpu-xpu", "nightly-xpu-kernel-wheel-1-gpu"]
+          rows = []
+          for suite in suites:
+              path = f"{suite}-metrics.jsonl"
+              if not os.path.exists(path):
+                  print(f"::warning::{path} not found")
+                  continue
+              for rec in map(json.loads, filter(str.strip, open(path))):
+                  if rec.get("kind") == "file":
+                      rows.append([rec["test_file"], suite, rec["status"], rec["duration"]])
+          with open("xpu-wheel-1-gpu-results.csv", "w", newline="") as f:
+              w = csv.writer(f)
+              w.writerow(["file_name", "suite", "status", "duration"])
+              w.writerows(rows)
+          print(f"Wrote {len(rows)} rows to xpu-wheel-1-gpu-results.csv")
+          EOF
+
+      - name: Upload per-file results CSV
+        if: always() && inputs.ref != ''
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        with:
+          name: xpu-wheel-1-gpu-results-csv
+          path: xpu-wheel-1-gpu-results.csv
+          if-no-files-found: warn
+          retention-days: 90
+
       - name: Cleanup container

         run: |
